assumptions.note: 4-star convention: C6 assumed, so the constellation-boosted talents (C3 Normal Attack, C5 skill) are baked at Lv13 while the burst stays Lv10. Offensive Directive is a Normal Attack parameter, so it is Lv13 too.

source.note: 7.2 character, added 2026-10-31 from nanoka 7.1.53 (pre-release data); neither Amber nor GO carry him yet, so the hit keys are OUR names (charged.mortarDmg = Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment, burst.shellDmg = one Thunderburst Shell projectile) and must be reconciled with GO once its sheet exists. Sword NA/CA/plunge are Physical; the Mortar is Electro.

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Offensive Directive, SELF half (not in Radiance): after the Mortar, Valeriy's own Electro hits (skill, burst, Thunderburst Shells) gain flat DMG = 51.68% of his ATK + A4 0.3% of his ATK per Impact Momentum the Mortar consumed, read live from his own ATK via electro_dmgIncFromAtk_. Pick the Momentum consumed. The Radiance half only buffs Stellar-Conduct DMG, which Valeriy does not deal. Offensive Directive is 15 stacks for 18s and each Electro instance consumes one (one per opponent hit) -- the pool is not enforced, so split the rotation with per-target bonusStats if it has more instances than stacks. The Mortar that grants the stacks does not consume one.

C6 The Strength to Breach Enemy Lines: Direct-Fire Mortar and the Thunderburst Shells deal 100% more DMG -- read as a DMG% bonus scoped to those two hits (valeriyc6_dmg_). The opponent-side crit half is the team entry c6ElectroCrit.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C2 Ranks That Charge as One: all nearby party members gain 100 EM for 18s after Valeriy uses his Elemental Skill (CD 10s, so permanent).

C6 The Strength to Breach Enemy Lines: opponents hit by the Mortar or a Thunderburst Shell take Electro DMG with +10% CRIT Rate for 7s, and Electro Stellar-Conduct DMG with an additional +40% CRIT DMG. Modelled as electro_critRate_ + stellarconduct_critDMG_ (every Stellar-Conduct hit so far is Electro or Cryo; a Cryo one would wrongly get the 40% here).

others_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Offensive Directive, OTHERS half, not in Radiance: after Valeriy's Direct-Fire Mortar, the active character's Electro DMG (Normal/Charged/Plunging/Skill/Burst) is increased by 51.68% of VALERIY's ATK (Normal Attack Lv13, C6 convention), plus A4 Into the Breach 0.3% of his ATK per Impact Momentum the Mortar consumed. The rates assume a full 100 Momentum (+30%), and 130 from C4 (constellationRates). Type his ATK; blank assumes 2,000. Offensive Directive is 15 stacks for 18s and each Electro instance consumes one (one per opponent hit) -- the pool is not enforced, so split the rotation with per-target bonusStats if it has more instances than stacks. The Mortar that grants the stacks does not consume one.

Offensive Directive, OTHERS half, Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: after Valeriy's Direct-Fire Mortar, the active character's Electro Stellar-Conduct DMG (lands on stellarconduct_dmgInc, outside the Stellar brackets) is increased by 155.04% of VALERIY's ATK (Normal Attack Lv13, C6 convention), plus A4 Into the Breach 0.9% of his ATK per Impact Momentum the Mortar consumed. The rates assume a full 100 Momentum (+90%), and 130 from C4 (constellationRates). Type his ATK; blank assumes 2,000. Offensive Directive is 15 stacks for 18s and each Electro instance consumes one (one per opponent hit) -- the pool is not enforced, so split the rotation with per-target bonusStats if it has more instances than stacks. The Mortar that grants the stacks does not consume one.

auto.name: Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to leap forward and slam the ground, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
When Valeriy has at least 40 <k>Impact Momentum</k>, he will consume all <k>Impact Momentum</k> to instead perform the special Charged Attack <k>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</k>.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Active Defense: Bastion Charge
skill.desc:
Valeriy raises his shield cannon and charges forward, dealing <e:electro>AoE Electro DMG</e>, gaining 40 <k>Impact Momentum</k>, and deploying a Supercharged Shield.
The Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption scales with Valeriy's ATK, and has 250% absorption efficiency against <e:electro></e>Electro DMG<e:electro></e>.

burst.name: Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo
burst.desc: Deals <e:electro>AoE Electro DMG</e> to nearby opponents and fires a <k>Thunderburst Shell</k> high into the air. The <k>Thunderburst Shell</k> disperses into a barrage of projectiles that rain down, dealing <e:electro>AoE Electro DMG</e> to nearby opponents.

passives.name: Advance With the Creeping Barrage
passives.desc: Valeriy gains 5 <k>Impact Momentum</k> whenever another nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an <e:electro>Electro</e> attack while the <k>Thunderburst Shells</k> from his Elemental Burst <k>Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo</k> are falling. He can gain up to 80 <k>Impact Momentum</k> in this way after each use of his Elemental Burst.

passives.name: Into the Breach
passives.desc:
<k>Offensive Directive</k> is enhanced based on the amount of <k>Impact Momentum</k> consumed when performing his special Charged Attack <k>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</k>. Each point consumed further increases the DMG Bonus granted by <k>Offensive Directive</k>. If Valeriy is:
· In the <k>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</k> state: Each point of <k>Impact Momentum</k> consumed increases this DMG Bonus by an amount equal to 0.9% of Valeriy's ATK;
· Not in the <k>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</k> state: Each point of <k>Impact Momentum</k> consumed increases this DMG Bonus by an amount equal to 0.3% of Valeriy's ATK.

passives.name: Subzero Conditioning
passives.desc: Valeriy enters the <k>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</k> state while within a <k>Polestar Field</k>.

passives.name: Tundra Operational Intelligence
passives.desc: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Snezhnaya (not including Nod-Krai) Expedition for 20 hours.

constellations.name: The Cadence of Suppressive Fire
constellations.desc:
Valeriy regenerates 6 Elemental Energy after performing the special Charged Attack <k>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</k>. For every 10 <k>Impact Momentum</k> consumed beyond 40 when performing this special Charged Attack, he regenerates an additional 1.5 Elemental Energy. Each time he performs <k>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</k>, he can regenerate up to 15 Elemental Energy in this way. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Additionally, each time Valeriy enters combat, the first time he uses his Elemental Skill <k>Active Defense: Bastion Charge</k>, he gains an additional amount of <k>Impact Momentum</k> equal to 150% of the amount normally gained.

constellations.name: Ranks That Charge as One
constellations.desc:
All nearby party members gain 100 Elemental Mastery for 18s after Valeriy uses his Elemental Skill <k>Active Defense: Bastion Charge</k>.
Additionally, while protected by a Supercharged Shield, if Valeriy is already at maximum <k>Impact Momentum</k>, any further <k>Impact Momentum</k> he would gain is instead converted into increased DMG Absorption for the shield. Each point of excess <k>Impact Momentum</k> increases the Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption by an amount equal to 8% of Valeriy's ATK. Up to 20 excess <k>Impact Momentum</k> can be converted in this way.

constellations.name: Vigilance at Close Quarters
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack <k>Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Fortitude Unshaken by Attrition
constellations.desc:
<k>Impact Momentum</k>'s limit is increased by 30, and its charging efficiency is increased by 30%.
Additionally, the Ascension Talent <k>Advance With the Creeping Barrage</k> is enhanced: The maximum amount of <k>Impact Momentum</k> that can be gained from this Talent after using the Elemental Burst is 104. You must unlock the Ascension Talent <k>Advance With the Creeping Barrage</k> to gain access to this effect.

constellations.name: Resolve to Divide and Destroy
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <k>Active Defense: Bastion Charge</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Strength to Breach Enemy Lines
constellations.desc: The special Charged Attack <k>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</k> and <k>Thunderburst Shells</k> from Elemental Burst <k>Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo</k> are enhanced: Their DMG is increased by 100%, and opponents they hit have the CRIT Rate of <e:electro>Electro DMG</e> they take increased by 10% for 7s. If the <e:electro>Electro DMG</e> taken is Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, that DMG instance's CRIT DMG is also increased by 40%.

auto.name: Tactique de garde : Épée et bouclier
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 3 coups d'épée.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour bondir en avant et frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT physiques aux ennemis proches.
Lorsque Valeriy possède au moins 40 pts d'<k>élan d'impact</k>, il consomme tout l'<k>élan d'impact</k> pour déclencher à la place l'attaque chargée spéciale <k>Mortier à tir direct : Bombardement à bout portant</k>.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis sur la route et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Défense active : Charge de bastion
skill.desc:
Valeriy brandit son canon-bouclier et charge en avant, infligeant des <e:electro>DGT Électro de zone</e>, gagnant 40 pts d'<k>élan d'impact</k> et déployant un bouclier super-chargé.
L'absorption de DGT du bouclier super-chargé est basée sur l'ATQ de Valeriy et ce dernier absorbe les <e:electro>DGT Électro</e> 250 % plus efficacement.

burst.name: Tir concentré : Salve éclair
burst.desc: Inflige des <e:electro>DGT Électro de zone</e> aux ennemis proches et tire un <k>obus foudroyant</k> en l'air. L'<k>obus foudroyant</k> se divise ensuite en une pluie de projectiles qui infligent des <e:electro>DGT Électro de zone</e> aux ennemis proches.

passives.name: Avancer avec le barrage rampant
passives.desc: Valeriy obtient 5 pts d'<k>élan d'impact</k> lorsqu'un autre personnage déployé de l'équipe à proximité touche un ennemi avec une attaque <e:electro>Électro</e> pendant la chute d'un <k>obus foudroyant</k> du déchaînement élémentaire <k>Tir concentré : Salve éclair</k>. Un maximum de 80 pts d'<k>élan d'impact</k> peut être obtenu de cette manière après chaque déchaînement élémentaire.

passives.name: Dans la brèche
passives.desc:
L'<k>ordre d'assaut</k> est renforcé selon la quantité d'<k>élan d'impact</k> consommée lors de l'attaque chargée spéciale <k>Mortier à tir direct : Bombardement à bout portant</k>, chaque pt d'<k>élan d'impact</k> augmentant davantage le bonus de DGT de l'<k>ordre d'assaut</k> :
· Si Valeriy est en <k>radiance « Astroconduction »</k> : chaque pt d'<k>élan d'impact</k> consommé augmente le bonus de DGT de l'<k>ordre d'assaut</k> d'une valeur équivalant à 0,9 % de l'ATQ de Valeriy.
· Si Valeriy n'est pas en <k>radiance « Astroconduction »</k> : chaque pt d'<k>élan d'impact</k> consommé augmente le bonus de DGT de l'<k>ordre d'assaut</k> d'une valeur équivalant à 0,3 % de l'ATQ de Valeriy.

passives.name: Conditionnement sous zéro
passives.desc: Valeriy passe en <k>radiance « Astroconduction »</k> dans une <k>étendue polaris</k>.

passives.name: Renseignements opérationnels sur la toundra
passives.desc: Augmente les récompenses d'une expédition de 20 h à Snezhnaya (hors Nod-Krai) de 25 %.

constellations.name: La cadence des tirs de suppression
constellations.desc:
Valeriy récupère 6 pts d'énergie élémentaire après avoir utilisé son attaque chargée spéciale <k>Mortier à tir direct : Bombardement à bout portant</k>, et 1,5 pts d'énergie élémentaire tous les 10 pts d'<k>élan d'impact</k> consommés par son attaque chargée spéciale au-dessus de 40. Valeriy peut récupérer un maximum de 15 pts d'énergie élémentaire de cette manière à chaque utilisation de son attaque chargée spéciale <k>Mortier à tir direct : Bombardement à bout portant</k>. Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 15 s.
La première fois que Valeriy utilise sa compétence élémentaire <k>Défense active : Charge de bastion</k> au début d'un combat, il obtient en plus 150 % des pts d'<k>élan d'impact</k> d'origine.

constellations.name: Des rangs qui chargent à l'unisson
constellations.desc:
La maîtrise élémentaire de tous les personnages de l'équipe à proximité augmente de 100 pts pendant 18 s après l'utilisation de la compétence élémentaire <k>Défense active : Charge de bastion</k>.
De plus, lorsque Valeriy est à la limite d'<k>élan d'impact</k> tout en étant protégé par un bouclier super-chargé, déclencher un effet accordant de l'<k>élan d'impact</k> augmente à la place l'absorption de DGT du bouclier super-chargé : chaque point d'<k>élan d'impact</k> en trop augmente l'absorption de DGT d'une valeur équivalant à 8 % de l'ATQ de Valeriy, un maximum de 20 pts d'<k>élan d'impact</k> en trop pouvant être converti de cette manière.

constellations.name: Vigilance à courte distance
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Tactique de garde : Épée et bouclier</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Force inébranlable face à l'usure
constellations.desc:
La limite d'<k>élan d'impact</k> augmente de 30 pts et son taux d'obtention augmente de 30 %.
De plus, l'effet de l'aptitude d'élévation <k>« Avancer avec le barrage rampant »</k> est renforcé : la limite d'<k>élan d'impact</k> pouvant être obtenu après chaque déchaînement élémentaire grâce à cette aptitude passe à 104 pts. L'aptitude d'élévation <k>« Avancer avec le barrage rampant »</k> doit être déjà débloquée.

constellations.name: Résolution de diviser et de détruire
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Défense active : Charge de bastion</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Force de percer les lignes ennemies
constellations.desc: L'attaque chargée spéciale <k>Mortier à tir direct : Bombardement à bout portant</k> et les <k>obus foudroyants</k> du déchaînement élémentaire <k>Tir concentré : Salve éclair</k> sont renforcés : les DGT infligés augmentent de 100 % et toucher un ennemi augmente le taux CRIT des <e:electro>DGT Électro</e> qu'il subit de 10 % pendant 7 s. Si les <e:electro>DGT Électro</e> subis sont considérés comme des DGT d'Astroconduction, leurs DGT CRIT augmentent également de 40 %.

auto.name: Táticas Druzhina: Ofensiva de Escudo e Espada
auto.desc:
<k>Ataque Normal</k>
Realiza até 3 golpes consecutivos.

<k>Ataque Carregado</k>
Consome uma certa quantidade de Stamina para saltar em frente, golpeando o chão e causando Dano Físico contra os inimigos próximos.
Quando Valeriy possuir pelo menos 40 de <k>Energia de Choque</k>, consumirá tudo de <k>Energia de Choque</k> para realizar o Ataque Carregado especial <k>Disparo de Morteiro: Bombardeio de Curta Distância</k>.

<k>Ataque Imersivo</k>
Mergulha em pleno ar para golpear o chão, causando dano aos inimigos ao longo do caminho e infligindo Dano em uma AdE durante o impacto.

skill.name: Defesa de Ofensiva: Ataque Relâmpago da Fortaleza
skill.desc:
Ergue o escudo e avança em frente, causando <e:electro>Dano Electro em AdE</e>, obtendo 40 de <k>Energia de Choque</k> e criando seu Escudo Eletrificado.
A absorção de Dano do Escudo Eletrificado é baseada no ATQ de Valeriy e possui 250% de eficácia contra <e:electro>Dano Electro</e>.

burst.name: Ponto de Fogo: Invasão Relâmpago
burst.desc: Causa <e:electro>Dano Electro em AdE</e> contra os inimigos próximos, e dispara para o alto o <k>Projétil Pesado Relampejante</k>. O <k>Projétil Pesado Relampejante</k> se separará em vários projéteis que cairão para o chão, causando <e:electro>Dano Electro em AdE</e>.

passives.name: Na Companhia de Balas
passives.desc: Na duração dos <k>Projéteis Pesados Relampejantes</k> que caem do Supremo <k>Ponto de Fogo: Invasão Relâmpago</k>, quando o ataque dos outros personagens ativos <e:electro>Electro</e> atingirem um inimigo, Valeriy obtém 5 de <k>Energia de Choque</k>. É possível obter até 80 de <k>Energia de Choque</k> por vez que lançar o Supremo dessa forma.

passives.name: Investida na Lacuna da Defesa
passives.desc:
<k>Ordem de Ataque</k> é fortalecida: baseado no consumo de <k>Energia de Choque</k> ao lançar o Ataque Carregado Especial <k>Disparo de Morteiro: Bombardeio de Curta Distância</k>, aumenta o Bônus de Dano de <k>Ordem de Ataque</k> para cada ponto de <k>Energia de Choque consumido</k>. Se Valeriy:
· Se estiver em <k>Brilho Reluzente: Supercondutor Estelar</k>: cada ponto de <k>Energia de Choque</k> consumido aumenta o Bônus de Dano de <k>Ordem de Ataque</k> em 0.9% do ATQ de Valeriy.
· Se não estiver em <k>Brilho Reluzente: Supercondutor Estelar</k>: cada ponto de <k>Energia de Choque</k> aumenta o Bônus de Dano de <k>Ordem de Ataque</k> em 0.3% do ATQ de Valeriy.

passives.name: Condicionamento Subzero
passives.desc: Valeriy entra no estado <k>Brilho Reluzente: Supercondutor Estelar</k> enquanto estiver dentro de um <k>Campo da Estrela Polar</k>.

passives.name: Inteligência sobre Operações na Tundra
passives.desc: Ganha 25% de recompensas a mais quando enviada numa Expedição em Snezhnaya (exceto Nod-Krai) por 20 horas.

constellations.name: Cadência do Fogo Supressor
constellations.desc:
Depois de realizar o Ataque Carregado especial <k>Disparo de Morteiro: Bombardeio de Curta Distância</k>, regenera 6 de Energia Elemental para Valeriy. Regenera mais 1.5 de Energia Elemental para cada 10 pontos consumidos de <k>Energia de Choque</k> acima de 40 ao realizar o Ataque Carregado especial. É possível regenerar até 15 de Energia Elemental para Valeriy por cada Ataque Carregado especial <k>Disparo de Morteiro: Bombardeio de Curta Distância</k>. Esse efeito pode ser desencadeado uma vez a cada 15s.
Além disso, na primeira vez que Valeriy lançar sua Habilidade Elemental <k>Defesa de Ofensiva: Ataque Relâmpago da Fortaleza</k> por vez que entrar em combate, obtém uma quantidade adicional de <k>Energia de Choque</k> equivalente a 150% da quantidade original.

constellations.name: Formação Acompanhante
constellations.desc:
Nos 18s após lançar a Habilidade Elemental <k>Defesa de Ofensiva: Ataque Relâmpago da Fortaleza</k>, aumenta a Proficiência Elemental de todos os membros próximos da equipe em 100.
Além disso, se estiver sob a proteção do Escudo Eletrificado e se Valeriy já tiver alcançado o máximo de <k>Energia de Choque</k>, ao ativar o efeito de obtenção de <k>Energia de Choque</k>, aumenta a absorção de Dano do Escudo Eletrificado. Cada 1 de <k>Energia de Choque</k> acima do máximo aumentam a absorção de Dano do Escudo Eletrificado em 8% do ATQ de Valeriy. É possível converter até 20 de <k>Energia de Choque</k> acima do máximo dessa forma.

constellations.name: Cautela de Combate Corpo-a-Corpo
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível do Ataque Normal <k>Táticas Druzhina: Ofensiva de Escudo e Espada</k> em 3.
Nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Resistência Destemida
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o máximo de <k>Energia de Choque</k> em 30, e aumenta a chance de obter em 30%.
Além disso, fortalece o efeito do Talento de Ascensão <k>Na Companhia de Balas</k>: é possível obter até 104 de <k>Energia de Choque</k> por vez que lançar o Supremo. É necessário desbloquear o Talento de Ascensão <k>Na Companhia de Balas</k>.

constellations.name: Determinação Destruidora
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível da Habilidade Elemental <k>Defesa de Ofensiva: Ataque Relâmpago da Fortaleza</k> em 3 níveis.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Poder da Operação de Infiltração
constellations.desc: O<k>Projétil Pesado Relampejante</k> do Ataque Carregado especial <k>Disparo de Morteiro: Bombardeio de Curta Distância</k> e do Supremo <k>Ponto de Fogo: Invasão Relâmpago</k> é fortalecido: aumenta o Dano causado em 100%, e aumenta a Taxa CRIT em 10% do <e:electro>Dano Electro</e> sofrido pelo inimigo por 7s após ele ser atingido. Se o <e:electro>Dano Electro</e> for Dano de Supercondutor Estelar, aumenta o Dano CRIT em 40%.
